### Describe the Bug

### Steps to Reproduce

2. Click on '....'
3. Perform action '....'
4. Observe error or unexpected behavior

### Expected Behavior
A clear and concise description of what you expected to happen.

### Screenshots or Terminal / Console Logs
If applicable, add screenshots or paste relevant terminal logs or browser console errors:
```
Paste error logs here
```

### Environment Information

- **Desktop Anki Version & AnkiConnect:** [e.g. Anki 24.06.3 + AnkiConnect v6]

### Additional Context
Add any other context about the problem here (e.g. data source type, document size, file format, Notion page layout).
